title: AI assistant
description: Just say or type what should change on your menu. You'll see exactly what happens first – nothing is saved without your approval.
placeholder: e.g. “Raise all drink prices by 5 % and round to 10 cents”
transcriptHint: From your voice recording – please check it quickly and correct if needed.
example1: Raise all drink prices by 5 % and round to 10 cents
example2: The schnitzel is sold out today
example3: Add tiramisu to the desserts for €6.90, with mascarpone and cocoa
example4: Rename the category Starters to Small bites
planning: The AI is planning your changes … this usually takes just a few seconds.
emptyHint: Please be a bit more specific, e.g. include the name of the dish.
voiceEmpty: Nothing could be understood in the recording.

voiceErrors.unsupported: Your browser doesn't support voice recording. Please type your instruction.
voiceErrors.denied: No microphone access. Please allow it in your browser settings.
voiceErrors.failed: The recording could not be processed.

previewHint: Check the changes and untick anything that shouldn't be applied.
dependsOnHint: Only created together with the new category.
conflictApply: The menu was changed since the preview ({names}). Please create a new preview.
noApplyPermission: You're not allowed to edit the menu – ask someone with edit rights to apply the changes.
applied: {count, plural, one {# change applied} other {# changes applied}}

notes.allergensRecheckConfirmed: Allergens were confirmed. They will be set to “needs review”.
notes.allergensMissing: No allergen information yet – please add it under “Review”.
notes.deleteUndoHint: Can be undone, but existing translations will be lost.
notes.cascadeItems: Also deletes {count, plural, one {# dish} other {# dishes}} in this category.

warnings.translationsStale: {count, plural, one {# translation becomes} other {# translations become}} outdated and should be reviewed.
warnings.allergensRecheck: The recipe changes for {count, plural, one {# dish} other {# dishes}} – re-check allergens.
warnings.allergensMissing: {count, plural, one {# new dish has} other {# new dishes have}} no allergen information yet.
warnings.itemLimit: Your plan allows at most {limit} dishes – some new dishes may not be created.
warnings.destructive: Contains deletions – you'll need to confirm them below.

dropped.unknownItem: A dish couldn't be matched clearly and was skipped.
dropped.unknownCategory: A category couldn't be matched and was skipped.
dropped.unknownMenu: A menu couldn't be matched and was skipped.
dropped.emptyName: An entry without a name was skipped.

historyEmpty: No changes made with the assistant yet.
conflictUndo: Undo isn't possible: {names} has been changed in the meantime. Please adjust the menu directly in the editor.
